battle.name: 出河店之戰
battle.brief: 遼天慶四年九月，完顏阿骨打率二萬精兵，與宋將童員所部在黑龍江肇州出河店合擊遼朝大軍。弩手是宋軍側翼唯一能封死退路的火力，卻隨全軍先潰而一矢未發。遼軍中軍被突破，死者以萬計，北宋聯金滅遼之局由此開端。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 出河店一役的三方是契丹帝國、女真完顏部聯軍與北宋，力量對比極不均衡。遼國由耶律氏建立，天祚帝耶律延禧在位時國勢已見崩解：北面樞密院掌軍令，五京留守分守南北，契丹、漢人、渤海、奚諸族各有兵籍與丁口，軍隊編制、馬政與裝備都不統一。出河店的遼軍由燕京以北的邊軍與京畿調來的騎兵組成，契丹重騎為骨幹，雜以漢兵、渤海兵與奚部部眾，糧秣靠沿途州縣供應，遠征之後人馬疲憊。金方此時尚無國家，以完顏部為核心的諸部聯盟推完顏阿骨打為都勃極烈，行軍分猛安、孛堇、謀克三級，精銳騎兵為主、步卒居次，全軍靠漁獵、掠奪與攻取州城的糧秣維繫，遠程攻城器械幾乎空白。北宋是第三方：宣和初年宋朝已遣使與女真議定聯合攻遼之策，出河店之役前由童員率禁軍與河北義兵北上，位置在遼軍側後，名義上負責截斷退路、策應夾擊，實際兵力有限，指揮體系另立而不隸屬金軍。
countriesEn: Three forces met at Chuhe Dian: the Khitan Liao empire, the Jurchen Wanyan tribal confederation that was to become Jin, and Northern Song, and the balance of power between them was extremely uneven. Liao had been founded by the Yelü house, and under the emperor Tianzong, Yelü Yanxi, the state was visibly coming apart: the Northern Privy Council issued the military orders, the garrison commanders of the five capitals governed north and south, and Khitans, Chinese, the descendants of the former Bohai kingdom and the Xi tribes each kept their own registers of men and their own obligations, so that the organisation of the armies, the remounting of horses and the equipment were all inconsistent. The Liao army at Chuhe Dian was drawn from the frontier troops north of the capital Yanjing and from cavalry transferred out of the capital region: heavily armed Khitan horse formed the backbone, mixed with Chinese soldiers, Bohai soldiers and men of the Xi tribes, and grain came from the prefectures along the line of march, so that men and horses were exhausted after the long advance. The Jin side had no state yet. An alliance of tribes centred on the Wanyan clan had appointed Wanyan Aguda as dudubolile, marched in the old Jurchen hierarchy of meng'an, boljin and mok'e, and counted its picked cavalry first and its foot soldiers second; the whole army lived off fishing, hunting, plunder and the grain of the prefectures it took, and it had almost no distant siege equipment at all. Northern Song was the third party: in the early years of the Xuanhe era the court had already sent envoys to the Jurchen and agreed on a joint plan to attack Liao, and before the battle of Chuhe Dian Tong Yuan led imperial guards and Hebei volunteers north, positioned behind the flank of the Liao army, nominally to cut the retreat route and support a pincer movement. The force was limited, and its command was a separate system that did not answer to the Jurchen.
people: 關鍵人物三方各有。完顏阿骨打是完顏部都勃極烈，出身猛安戶，自幼習騎射，目睹女真丁口被強行括入軍籍、部落首長被誣告下獄，於遼天慶四年在寧州聚眾起事，先取寧州、曉古倫一帶的據點，隨即以孤軍迎擊遼朝大軍；出河店是他第一次在正面野戰中擊潰遼主大軍，也是女真勢力由部落聯盟走向國家的轉折點。完顏撒改是起義核心之一，與阿骨打、吳帶議定建國方略；完顏吳帶隨行陣前，早逝。遼方的天祚帝耶律延禧在此之前已因朝政混亂、皇族與后妃爭權而大失人心，出河店的出兵由他決定，但主將的姓名在《金史》《宋史》及遼代文獻中均未詳載，只能確定此軍規模遠大於金軍，且遠道而來。北宋方面的童員是河北人，主張乘金滅遼之機取燕京，出河店是他第一次率宋軍與女真協同作戰。同一條外交線上還有奉議大夫馬政，他早年奉命赴女真、會寧府探看虛實，促成宋金之間的初步默契；宣和二年雙方正式訂立海上之盟，則是出河店之後的事。遼朝經營東北的另外一批人物是契丹諸部首領與燕京的漢人官員：前者在阿骨打的攻勢下各自求存，後者在金軍破中都之後大批降附，成為金朝接管漢地的重要骨幹。
peopleEn: The decisive figures come from all three sides. Wanyan Aguda was dudubolile of the Wanyan clan, born into a meng'an household and a horseman and archer from childhood; having seen Jurchen able-bodied men counted into the Liao registers by force and tribal headmen arrested on accusation, he mustered the tribes at Ningzhou in the fourth year of Liao's Tianqing era and took the strongpoints at Ningzhou and Xiaogulun, then met the Liao host with a lone army. Chuhe Dian was the first time he broke a Liao army in the open field, and it was the turning point that carried the Jurchen from tribal confederation toward statehood. Wanyan Sagai was one of the core conspirators and worked out the plan for founding the state with Aguda and Wudai; Wanyan Wudai served in the field and died young. On the Liao side, the emperor Tianzong Yelü Yanxi had already lost much of his authority through disorder in the court and the quarrels of the imperial clan and the consorts, and the decision to send out the army at Chuhe Dian was his; but the name of the commander is nowhere recorded in the History of Jin, the History of Song or the surviving Liao documents, and all that can be established is that this army was far larger than the Jurchen force and had come a long way. For Song, Tong Yuan was a man of Hebei who argued for taking Yanjing while Jin destroyed Liao, and Chuhe Dian was the first time he led Song troops in cooperation with the Jurchen. On the same diplomatic line stood Ma Zheng, who was sent to the Jurchen and to Huining Prefecture to sound out the situation and who brought about the first working understanding between Song and Jin; the formal Sea Alliance between the two was concluded only in the second year of the Xuanhe era, after Chuhe Dian. The other actors on the Liao side were the Khitan tribal chiefs and the Chinese officials of Yanjing: the former each looked for their own survival as Aguda's advance closed over the north-east, while the latter, after the fall of the Central Capital, submitted in great numbers and became the backbone of the Jin administration of the Chinese lands.
kits: 本戰的卡面兵器是弩，準確地說是宋軍的弩兵裝備。弩身以木為體，弦蓄滿之後由機括扣發，張弦需人踏弦或以蹶張之法絞緊，一支弩矢自裝填到射出往往要兩人配合，射速每分鐘不過一兩矢；但單矢的初速與穿透力遠勝長弓，鐵鏃加木桿的弩箭對密集的騎兵陣形尤其有效。宋軍步軍編制中設弩手營，與弓手混編，《武經總要》所載的原則是弩手自備短刀，由身側的長兵與弓手補上重新上弦的空隙；威力最大的神臂弓在北宋前期已入軍器籍，可用於野戰精確射擊與城頭遠射。出河店是開闊的江邊平原，遼軍以密集的騎兵集群前突，弩在這種地形本來有兩重任務：一是居高臨下壓制遼軍先鋒，二是在側翼封住潰退的通道，正好對應作戰計劃中宋軍的位置。實際結果是宋軍未等女真發動便先自潰，弩手隨陣脫離，這批弩箭一矢未發；成建制的弩兵第一次作為固定火力投入宋金協同作役，卻完全沒有兌現。往後看，金人南征時曾仿造宋式神臂弓與床子弩，把宋的弩技搬去對付宋的城防；宋在野戰中屢屢倚重弩手的定點射擊，卻一直受制於裝填遲緩、兵力單薄，一旦指揮中斷便成為潰退時的累贅——這一課正是從出河店這一戰開始的。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the crossbow, more precisely the crossbow equipment of the Song infantry. The stock is timber, the bow is drawn and held by a latch mechanism, the string is bent either by trampling it down with the foot or by winding it with a windlass, and getting a single bolt from loaded to loosed generally takes two men; the rate of fire is no more than one or two bolts a minute. But the velocity and penetration of a single bolt far exceed those of a longbow, and an iron-headed bolt with a wooden shaft is particularly effective against a massed cavalry formation. The Song infantry establishment included crossbow units mixed in with archers, and the principle recorded in the Wujing Zongyao is that a crossbowman carries a short blade of his own and that the pikemen and archers at his side cover the interval while he reloads; the most powerful type, the shenbi crossbow, was already entered in the Song armory registers in the early Northern Song and served both for precise shooting in the field and for long-range fire from the parapet. Chuhe Dian was an open plain by the river, and the Liao army attacked in dense clusters of horse, so the crossbow had two jobs in that country: to shoot down into the Liao vanguard from a rise, and to seal the flank route of retreat, which was precisely the position assigned to the Song troops in the plan of battle. In the event the Song army broke before the Jurchen had even struck, and the crossbowmen left with the rout; not one of those bolts was ever fired. A formed body of crossbowmen was committed for the first time as fixed firepower in a Song-Jin combined operation, and it produced nothing at all. Looking forward, when the Jin campaigned south they copied Song-pattern shenbi crossbows and bed crossbows and turned Song crossbow technology against Song city walls. Song in the field leaned again and again on the aimed shot of its crossbowmen, yet remained hobbled by slow loading, thin numbers and the fact that once command broke down the crossbowmen became a liability in a rout; that lesson began with this battle at Chuhe Dian.
tactics: 女真的戰法是典型的以少擊多，可以分成四段。蓄勢：起兵之後先取寧州、曉古倫等據點，屯馬備械，把馬群餵到能連日馳騁的狀態，同時派出小股騎兵監視遼境烽燧。待機：遼朝大軍自燕京方向壓來，糧道拉長，人馬疲敝，女真不急著正面迎擊，只在出河店一帶的江邊草甸、沼澤與柳林之間選地設伏，營地不設在樹林裡，以免被對方騎兵遠望發現火光。奇襲：夜裡馬上裹蹄、兵員銜枚，步卒負薪草潛行逼近，天明前發動；女真步卒以長槊、大盾列陣，硬頂遼騎第一波衝鋒，騎兵則繞到遼軍側後，專打中軍旗帳所在。追殲：遼軍中軍一破，全軍崩潰，騎兵互相踐踏，屍橫遍野；女真不急著收兵，反覆切斷潰兵與渡口、營寨之間的聯繫，縱騎追出數百里，奪其馬匹、甲兵與糧秣。配合的宋軍本應在遼軍側後點火截殺，結果先一步崩潰，牽制的效果全無，女真不得不獨力承擔正面壓力。遼方的戰術問題出在情報與地形：出河店的具體位置在遼廷並不熟悉，倉促扎營，營地與水源之間的距離拉得過長，前鋒與中軍缺乏連鎖，騎兵出營時不按陣次，於是一被夜襲切斷便各自為戰。
tacticsEn: The Jurchen method is the classic victory of few over many, and it falls into four stages. Preparation: after the rising they took strongpoints such as Ningzhou and Xiaogulun, stabled horses and stored arms, fed the herds until they could gallop for days on end, and sent out small parties of horse to watch the Liao beacon stations. Waiting: the Liao host came pressing down from the direction of Yanjing with its supply line stretched thin and its men and horses worn out, and the Jurchen did not hurry to meet it in the open. They chose their ground in the meadow, marsh and willow stands along the river around Chuhe Dian, and did not camp among the trees, where the enemy's horse might see the light of their fires from a distance. Surprise: in the night the horses were muffled and the men marched with bits held, the foot soldiers carrying brushwood to creep up, and the attack was launched before dawn. The Jurchen foot formed up with long spears and large shields, absorbed the first charge of the Liao horse, while their cavalry worked round behind the Liao line to strike at the centre where the command banners and tents stood. Annihilation: once the centre of the Liao army broke, the whole army dissolved, horse trampling horse, and the ground was covered with the dead. The Jurchen did not rush to gather spoil; they worked again and again to cut the defeated from the fords and from their camps, and rode out for hundreds of li, taking horses, armour and grain. The Song troops were to have fired the Liao rear from the flank, but they broke first, the whole point of the pincer was lost, and the Jurchen were left to carry the weight of the frontal battle alone. The Liao tactical failure lay in intelligence and in the ground: the Liao court was unfamiliar with the exact position of Chuhe Dian, camped in haste, stretched the distance between the camp and its water too far, and had no chain of connection between vanguard and centre; the horse left the camp without being formed up in order, and once the line was cut by a night attack every unit fought for itself.
data: 可核的數字不多，能夠確立的只有這些。時間：遼天慶四年、金天會二年，即 1114 年，此役在九月；距同年十一月的寧江州之戰只有兩個月，距翌年正月金軍攻取黃龍府與建國不到半年。地理：出河店在今黑龍江省肇州縣一帶的松花江中游北岸，位於金上京會寧府（今哈爾濱市阿城區）東北約二百餘里；戰場是江邊沖積草原、沼澤與柳林相間的開闊地，河道在初冬已封凍，結冰的江面反而便利了騎兵調動。兵力：金軍為二萬精騎，是《金史》一貫的記載；遼軍人數的記載從七萬到十萬不等，多數取十萬上下；宋軍接應部隊的規模沒有明文，只知以禁軍與河北義兵為主，總數當在數萬之數。損耗：遼軍死者以萬計、屍橫遍野，被俘與散失的馬匹甲兵不可勝數，金軍以輕騎追擊數百里而自身折損有限。時間與路程：遼軍自燕京方向出發，至出河店已行數百里以上，糧道一經遼境接管便不斷拉長。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are scarce, and only a few can be established. Date: the fourth year of Liao's Tianqing era, the second year of Jin's Tianhui era, that is 1114, and the campaign fell in the ninth month; it was only two months before the battle for Ningjiang Prefecture later in the same year, and less than half a year before the Jin took Huanglong Prefecture and proclaimed the state in the first month of the following year. Geography: Chuhe Dian lay on the north bank of the middle Songhua River in what is now Zhaozhou county in Heilongjiang, some two hundred li north-east of Jin's Upper Capital of Huining Prefecture, at modern Acheng in Harbin. The battlefield was open country where the floodplain meadow, the marsh and the willow stands met along the river; the channel had already frozen in early winter, and the ice made it easier for the horse to move about. Numbers: the Jurchen force of twenty thousand picked riders is the standing figure in the History of Jin; for the Liao army the accounts run from seventy thousand to a hundred thousand, and most readings take something near a hundred thousand; the size of the Song contingent is nowhere stated in figures, only that it consisted of imperial guards and Hebei volunteers and must have numbered several tens of thousands. Losses: the Liao dead were counted in tens of thousands and the ground was covered with bodies, horses and armour fell to the enemy in numbers that the sources call past counting, and the Jurchen, pursuing on light horse for hundreds of li, lost little themselves. Time and distance: the Liao army had marched several hundred li from the direction of Yanjing before it reached Chuhe Dian, and the line of supply lengthened at every stage as it took over from the Liao prefectures.
cause: 打起來的緣由有三層。最遠的一層是遼廷對女真的逼迫：耶律延禧把女真丁口強行編入軍籍，部落首長被誣告下獄，遼使與軍將不斷越境括戶索人，怨氣積了十餘年；1113 年阿骨打曾以祖父烏雅乃的名義交涉索回叛戶，事敗之後烏雅乃病故，次年阿骨打收拾舊部在寧州舉兵，寧州、曉古倫連下之後，遼廷的反擊被迫升級。直接的一層是遼軍的傾巢出擊：遼廷不能容忍女真奪取沿邊州縣，於是集中燕京以北的邊軍與京畿騎兵深入女真腹地，想在一次會戰中把新生的女真武裝摧毀，而女真則利用對方遠道而來的疲憊，選擇自己熟悉的江邊地勢迎戰。第三層是宋方的介入：北宋打著收復燕雲十六州的主意，派童員率禁軍與河北義兵北上策應，等於給了金軍一次在野戰中試探遼虛實的機會。三層疊在一起，原本可以以朝貢與括戶交涉收場的邊境衝突，就這樣變成一次三方在松花江畔的會戰，而它留下的直接後果，是宋金之間那條以共同敵人為名的合作線。
causeEn: The coming to blows had three layers. The most distant was the pressure the Liao court put on the Jurchen: Yelü Yanxi had the Jurchen able-bodied counted into the military registers by force, tribal headmen arrested on accusation, and Liao envoys and officers repeatedly crossing the border to seize men and count households, so that resentment had built for more than a decade. In 1113 Aguda had tried, in the name of his grandfather Uya'na, to negotiate for the return of those who had fled; after that attempt failed Uya'na fell ill and died, and in the following year Aguda gathered the old partisans and rose at Ningzhou. Once Ningzhou and Xiaogulun had fallen, the Liao counterattack was forced up a notch. The immediate layer was the Liao concentration for a single decisive stroke: the court could not tolerate the Jurchen taking the frontier prefectures, so it concentrated the frontier troops north of Yanjing and the cavalry of the capital region and drove deep into Jurchen country, hoping to destroy the newly raised Jurchen armed force in a single pitched battle, and the Jurchen answered by choosing the river country they knew and letting the enemy's long march exhaust itself. The third layer was the intervention of Song: the Northern Song wanted the Sixteen Prefectures back, and sent Tong Yuan north with imperial guards and Hebei volunteers to cover the movement, which in effect gave the Jurchen a chance to sound out the Liao in the open field. With all three layers stacked together, a frontier quarrel that might have been settled over tribute and the counting of households turned into a three-sided battle on the banks of the Songhua, and what it left behind directly was the line of cooperation between Song and Jin, held together by a common enemy.
impact: 出河店一役的後果遠出戰場之外。它是女真第一次在正面野戰中擊垮遼朝大軍，遼的士氣、將領的信心與天祚帝的威信同時受損，此後遼廷在東北的應對一路走低，寧江州與黃龍府相繼失守，到 1115 年正月金國建立的時候，遼在江北的邊防體系已基本瓦解。對宋而言，此役一方面證明了聯金滅遼的可行性，另一方面也暴露了宋軍的致命弱點：宋兵在未經接戰時即自潰，裝備精良的弩兵與禁軍在真實的會戰中不堪使用。這種認識直接催生了宣和二年（1120）的海上之盟，宋金聯軍滅遼，宋人指望金人攻燕京、遼人打盡北疆，自己坐收燕雲十六州；1122 年金人破燕京，1125 年遼亡，結果燕雲未歸宋，反而金人長驅南下，1127 年靖康之變北宋覆亡。一場本為取回失地而打的戰役，換來的是另一個王朝的傾覆。從裝備史的角度看，出河店是弩在兩宋與金之間地位轉移的起點：弩在宋手裡是野戰的定點火力，在金手裡則成了被仿製、被反向運用的攻城器械，技術的流動往往比疆域的流動更早完成。
impactEn: The consequences of Chuhe Dian reached far beyond the field itself. It was the first time the Jurchen broke a Liao army in open battle, and the morale of the Liao, the confidence of its commanders and the authority of Tianzong were all damaged at once; from then on the Liao court's response in the north-east only went downhill, Ningjiang Prefecture and Huanglong Prefecture were lost in turn, and by the time Jin was proclaimed in the first month of 1115 the Liao border system north of the river had already largely come apart. For Song the campaign proved at one and the same time that a joint war against Liao was feasible and that the Song army had a fatal weakness: the Song troops broke before they were ever engaged, and well-equipped crossbowmen and imperial guards proved unusable in a real pitched battle. That realisation directly produced the Sea Alliance of the second year of the Xuanhe era (1120). Song and Jin destroyed Liao together, Song expecting that the Jin would batter Yanjing and the Liao would be exhausted in the north while Song simply picked up the Sixteen Prefectures; the Jin took Yanjing in 1122, Liao fell in 1125, but the Sixteen Prefectures did not go to Song, and instead the Jin drove south, and in 1127 the Jingkang disaster ended the Northern Song. A war fought in order to recover lost territory ended in the collapse of a different dynasty. From the point of view of the history of arms, Chuhe Dian is where the standing of the crossbow began to shift between the Song and the Jin: in Song hands the crossbow was aimed field firepower, in Jin hands it became siege equipment that was copied and turned back against its maker, and technology usually travels faster than territory does.
result: 結果是金軍大勝，宋軍先潰。遼軍中軍被突破，主力崩潰，士卒死傷以萬計，馬匹、甲兵與器械被大量奪取，殘部北潰，金軍追擊數百里；宋軍在側翼的策應完全落空，弩手與弓手在需要封死退路的時刻離陣，這批弩箭最終一矢未發。天祚帝自此再無能力組織東北的會戰，只能退守中京一線，遼的覆亡從此進入倒數。對弩這種兵器而言，出河店留下一個刺眼的註腳：它有射程、有穿透力、有可倚賴的編制，卻受制於裝填遲緩與指揮崩潰，在一次以少勝多的會戰中淪為看客；真正決定勝負的是女真的騎兵速度、夜襲的節奏，以及對戰場地形的熟悉程度。以後宋人屢次在野戰中倚重弩兵，卻始終沒有解決「弓弩手一旦失去統一指揮便隨陣瓦解」的難題，直到宋金戰爭後期、南宋對蒙古的後期戰役裡，弩兵都還在重演同樣的處境。
resultEn: The result was a decisive Jurchen victory and a premature Song rout. The centre of the Liao army was broken, the main body dissolved, casualties ran into the tens of thousands, horses, armour and equipment were taken in quantity, the survivors fled north, and the Jurchen pursued them for hundreds of li. The Song flanking operation came to nothing: the crossbowmen and the archers left the line at the very moment when the retreat route had to be sealed, and not one of those bolts was ever fired. From then on Tianzong could no longer muster a pitched battle in the north-east and could only fall back on the line of the Central Capital, and the destruction of Liao entered its countdown. For the crossbow itself the battle left a glaring footnote: it had range, it had penetration, it had an organisation that could be relied on, and yet it was hobbled by slow loading and by a command structure that fell apart, and in a famous victory of few over many it was reduced to a spectator. What decided the day was the speed of the Jurchen horse, the tempo of the night attack and the familiarity with the ground. Song relied on crossbowmen in the field many times afterwards, yet never solved the problem that bowmen and crossbowmen dissolve with the army once unified command is lost, and the same condition was still being reenacted in the late wars of the Song against the Mongols. In a word, the crossbow fired not a single arrow at Chuhe Dian, and the battle was won by the Jurchen alone.
